notes.content:

Ahnayro owners will now unlock an exclusive new skin in NITE Team 4. This skin automatically unlocks if you have Ahnayro in your steam library.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/5878712ad8e8bbd0b377dc811ca11524ed19ba0d.gif

NITE Team 4 is the hacking and cyber warfare extension of The Black Watchmen universe, including training center for new players with no past knowledge of hacking, a new mission campaign in the universe of Black Watchmen, hourly and daily bounties, players created servers, open world missions and sets of online investigation and puzzles.

You can get NT4 on sales right now here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/544390/NITE_Team_4/

notes.title: Table 2 Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/33add2a3fd0767a69a1d5d793fc8112ac665e235.png


TABLE 2 HAS BEEN RELEASED!
Enter the depths of a new dream, and explore the dark world of Voodoo. Go deeper into the life of the dreamer as you uncover details of her waking life as well as her unconscious through transmedia storytelling accessible with the new Artifact gateway. Delve into the rituals, dolls, yellow death and theinvisible gods of Voodoo 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/bae01c78d960af6b362ffca97a07d304a1953585.png

We have worked for months on game elements which add significant depth to the experience of Ahnayro. We strongly believe these additions will increase the level of immersion in the game and make the puzzles more complex and rewarding. Our table 2 update gives you a preview of all we have been working on. 



http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/0ff79177d518be0d353fc71c6d1670255b64f003.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/ccddf4f2d3e4f23cc0f5e0a4146f383d9a3c8d1d.jpg

The Artifact is the game’s progression map. It serves as a navigation tool into the dream world and the waking realm, and shows you the connections between both in the protagonist’s story. The waking life of the dreamer unfolds through narrative transmedia (blogs, Tumblr, images, etc) and ARG puzzles. You will also encounter dream gates in the Artifact, which serve as both tests and sources of information for the walking realm. Passing through these gates will yield Steam achievements! 

We have unlocked a limited number of the transmedia elements to test the effectiveness of the storytelling methods. We will adjust the techniques used according to your feedback and open the rest of the map upon release of the full game. 



http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/b0710858ba515f60e20fdb17c35cbfbc079c80d8.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/74f5556441e20a979d84a640fe426b8052a59c1b.jpg

A second guardian spirit is introduced to you in Table 2, along with the theme of Voodoo. For this table, we have changed our approach to fragment riddles to create a clear sense of progression within each puzzle. These new fragments give you a starting point with the riddle and certain images, and the remaining images, text and the narration act as checkpoints, showing you that you are on the right path in your investigation. 

We have also redone certain fragments in Table 1 to reflect this new puzzle design structure. We hope you find the new system helpful, and we look forward to hearing your feedback!

Don't forget to visit us on the forums to discuss these changes, meet your fellow oneironauts and get updates on the content to come in the full release!

notes.title: Table 2 Announcement
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/KKuXjpb.jpg

Dear Dreamers,

Thank you for your support during the Early Access of Ahnayro and for giving us such valuable feedback about the game.

Second Table
Table 2 will bring you deeper into the dream universe - introducing you to the realm of VOODOO. 

We cannot tell you anything else, as it could spoil your future investigations but it may be a good time to brush up on your history of Vévé symbolism. Keep an eye open in the forums and our social media as leaked content may appear.

This new update will be released in August along with 12 new fragments to investigate. If you did not complete the end game ARG yet, it’s still time to jump in. Just head to the official game forums.

If you had not already had a chance to do so, please take the time to review the game on steam or fill out the survey at the end of table 1, it is extremely valuable for us!


It's time to go to sleep now... time to go to sleep... 
- The Dev Team

notes.title: Dev Update #001
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all, a big thank you for all your feedback, we are very excited after this weekend's launch! Today we pushed some bug fixes on the production server:

Ahnayro Patch Notes:

    Made the whole screen clickable to continue on tutorial and table intro/outro texts 
    Fixed dynamic font display during tutorial
    Better support for smaller resolutions and displays
    Replay button added for table intros
    Grammar correction on intro text to table 1


Don't forget to visit us on the forums. We are a really welcoming community and would love to hear you!

notes.title: Ahnayro begins first week on Early Access!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/h9bIVuY.jpg
Ahnayro: The Dream World is now in its first week of Early Access.

We are excited to bring this new extension of our universe to the Steam community and receive your feedback. 

If you’d like to discuss the game, chat with us or submit a bug report, please join our forums at forums.ahnayro.com.

See you in the Dream World!
